factual_errors.text: on average, people in London and the South East earn more, live longer and are more likely to have a job than people in much of the north, Wales and Northern Ireland
factual_errors.correction: London and the South East do have higher average earnings and longer life expectancy. They do not both have better job chances. The South East has a low unemployment rate. London's unemployment rate is among the highest of any UK region, and its employment rate is not above all northern regions. Northern Ireland usually has one of the lowest unemployment rates in the UK. The divide in jobs is better described as wages, types of job and economic inactivity, not as London people being more likely to have a job.
